BLOCK1.html: I'm Reaz Romen, a CTO and systems engineer working across embedded computing, communications, infrastructure, and applied AI.

BLOCK2.html: My work often starts below the application layer: firmware, audio paths, network protocols, device telemetry, distributed services, and the infrastructure required to operate them reliably.

BLOCK3.html: I like systems where hardware, networks, and software meet. That might mean tracing an RTP stream, debugging an ESP32 audio path, designing a backend control plane, instrumenting a distributed service, or following a signal from a physical sensor all the way to an operational dashboard.

BLOCK4.html: For me, programming is less about a particular language and more about building systems that solve real problems. Code is one layer. The interesting part is understanding how the layers interact, where they fail, and how to make the whole system dependable.

BLOCK5.html: I currently work as CTO at LOUPKIDS, where my work spans embedded firmware, real-time communications, backend architecture, device infrastructure, and production operations.
